text: {"batchcomplete":true,"query":{"pages":[{"pageid":19922857,"ns":0,"title":"Scalar implicature","extract":"In pragmatics, scalar implicature, or quantity implicature, is an implicature that attributes an implicit meaning beyond the explicit or literal meaning of an utterance, and which suggests that the utterer had a reason for not using a more informative or stronger term on the same scale.
